==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Western Provinces" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Kill an [[Elf]] with a [[Crystal bow]].
''Note: an inactive bow can be used if equipped whilst the elf dies to poison.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Roving Elves]]
*{{SCP|Ranged|70|link=y}} {{boostable|n}}
*[[Crystal bow]] or [[Bow of faerdhinen]]
|-
|2. Catch and cook a [[Monkfish]] in [[Piscatoris]].
''Note: [[Monkfish]] is caught in the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Swan Song]]
*{{SCP|Fishing|62|link=y}} and {{SCP|Cooking|62|link=y}}
*[[Small fishing net]]
|-
|3. Complete a Veteran game of [[Pest Control]].
''Note: You must've earnt [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]] for this task to count as completed. In Deadman Mode, the task is instead "Attempt to board the veteran Pest Control lander with at least 100 combat."''
|
*{{SCP|Combat|100|link=y}}
|-
|4. Catch a [[Dashing Kebbit]].
''Note: This [[kebbit]] is found in the [[Piscatoris falconry area]].'' 
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|69|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*500 [[coins]]
|-
|5. Complete a lap of the [[Ape Atoll agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Monkey Madness I]]
*{{SCP|Agility|48|link=y}}
*[[Ninja monkey greegree]] or [[Kruk monkey greegree]] (other [[greegree]]s will cause you to fail the course)
|-
|6. Chop and burn some [[Mahogany logs]] on [[Ape Atoll]].
''Note: Logs burnt by the [[Infernal axe]] do not count towards this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Monkey Madness I]]
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|50|link=y}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|50|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]] (excluding [[felling axe]]s) and a [[tinderbox]]
*
|-
|7. Mine some [[Adamantite ore]] in [[Tirannwn]].
''Note: This can be done in the [[Isafdar mine]] outside of [[Lletya]], or the [[Trahaearn mine]] in [[Prifddinas]] (with completion of [[Song of the Elves]]).''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Regicide]]
*{{SCP|Mining|70|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|8. Check the health of your [[Palm tree]] in [[Lletya]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Mourning's End Part I]]
*{{SCP|Farming|68|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*[[Palm sapling]], [[rake]], and [[spade]]
*15 [[Papaya fruit|papayas]] recommended to pay the [[Liliwen|gardener]]
|-
|9. Claim a [[Chompy bird hat]] from [[Rantz]] after registering at least 300 kills.
''Note: You need to have a ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]] in your inventory to claim hats.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]
*[[Ogre bellows]], ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]], and [[ogre arrows|ogre]] or [[brutal arrows]]
*300 [[chompy bird|chompy]] or [[jubbly bird]] kills
|-
|10. Build an [[Isafdar (painting)|Isafdar painting]] in your [[Hall (quest trophies)|POH Quest hall]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Roving Elves]]
*{{SCP|Construction|65|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*3 [[mahogany plank]]s, [[saw]], and [[hammer]]
*[[Isafdar painting]] (bought from [[Sir Renitee]] for 2,000 [[coins]])
*25,000 [[coins]] to construct a [[Hall (quest trophies)|Quest Hall]] if you haven't already
|-
|11. Kill [[Zulrah]].
''Note: In Deadman Mode, the task is listed as "Attempt to visit Zulrah.", but doing so will not complete the task, and you must kill Zulrah like normal to complete it.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Regicide]]
*See the [[Zulrah/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|12. Teleport to [[Ape Atoll]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of the [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei|Awowogei subquest]] of [[Recipe for Disaster]] 
*{{SCP|Magic|64|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
*Means to cast [[Ape Atoll Teleport (standard)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Law=2|Fire=2|Water=2|Banana=1}})
|-
|13. Pickpocket a [[Gnome]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|75|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 3]]:
**Depicts a [[gnome child]]
**One daily teleport to the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Rantz]] offers you 100 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|100}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*[[Teleport crystal]]s will now hold up to 5 charges, up from 3
*The [[void knight top]] and [[void knight robe|robe]] can now be upgraded into an [[elite void top]] and [[elite void robe|robe]] for 200 [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]] each, by speaking to the [[Elite Void Knight]]
*Access to the room with the [[monkey skull]] in the [[Temple of Marimbo Dungeon]], allowing you to make the [[ancient gorilla greegree]]
*Access to the [[Hunting expert]]'s private [[Red chinchompa hunting ground]]
*[[Islwyn]] now sells [[Crystal halberd]]s for 750,000 [[coins]], which can be wielded with 70 [[Attack]] and 35 [[Strength]], and you gain the ability to create them yourself (with 78 [[Crafting]] and 78 [[Smithing]])
